newsitem.title: GERMANY: Condor resumes Brazil flight, adds Myanma.
newsitem.headline: Condor resumes Brazil flight, adds Myanma.

text.p: Condor Flugdienst GmbH, the charter carrier of Deutsche Lufthansa AG, said it will resume flights to Brazil and start services to Myanmar and Trinidad in its winter schedule starting November 1.
The airline said in a statement it will fly to Salvador da Bahia from Cologne on Tuesdays using a Boeing 767-300 aircraft, resuming a service dropped on June 10 due to poor passenger demand.
Condor said it will launch a new flight from Frankfurt to Trinidad on Tuesdays with a B767-300 aircraft this winter.

A new B767 flight on Tuesdays from Frankfurt to Yangon (Rangoon), capital of Myanmar (Burma), with a return via Phuket in Thailand will be used by tour operators for cultural package tours, the company statement added.
Rising demand for Egypt holidays means the airline will fly weekly to the Red Sea resort of Hurghada from nine German airports, it said.
In all, Condor said it will fly to more than 55 destinations in 34 countries in its winter schedule.
